我們聽見路上傳來馬蹄聲。
A crystal chandelier hung above the dining table.
餐桌上方懸掛著一盞水晶吊燈。
The lobby's huge chandelier lit up the whole room.
大廳那盞巨大的吊燈照亮了整個空間。
The river was contaminated by waste from the factory.
那條河被工廠的廢料汙染了。
Do not drink contaminated water.
不要喝受汙染的水。
He characteristically arrived early and left late.
他一貫是早到晚退。
She answered the question characteristically with a joke.
她照例用一個笑話回答了這個問題。
The rescue was a well-coordinated effort between several teams.
這次救援是幾個團隊協調配合的成果。
Her outfit was neatly coordinated in shades of blue.
她的穿搭以不同深淺的藍色搭得很協調。

coordinated.zh: 協調、統籌（coordinate 的過去式）
ai: She coordinated the schedules of all the volunteers.
她統籌了所有志工的時間表。
The teacher coordinated the school trip with three other classes.
老師與另外三個班級協調安排了校外教學。
My boots were covered in muck after the walk.
散步後，我的靴子沾滿了爛泥。
The farmer spread muck on the field in spring.
農夫在春天把肥料撒在田裡。
Don't muck up the plan at the last minute.
別在最後一刻把計畫搞砸。
The kids mucked up their clean shoes in the garden.
孩子們在花園裡把乾淨的鞋子弄髒了。

formative.zh: 形成期的、對成長有重大影響的
ai: The early years are formative for a child's personality.
早年時期對孩子的個性形成影響重大。
Living abroad was a formative experience for her.
住在國外對她來說是一段影響深遠的成長經歷。
We had a picnic on a grassy hill.
我們在一座長滿青草的小山丘上野餐。
The path ended at a grassy field.
小路的盡頭是一片草地。
She looked at the old food with distaste.
她帶著厭惡的表情看著那些放久的食物。
He has a strong distaste for loud parties.
他非常不喜歡吵鬧的派對。
The children clambered over the rocks to reach the beach.
孩子們手腳並用爬過岩石，來到海灘。
He clambered into the truck and closed the door.
他笨拙地爬上卡車，關上車門。
The baby had rosy cheeks after playing in the cold.
嬰兒在冷天裡玩過後，臉頰紅撲撲的。
The sky turned rosy at sunrise.
日出時天空染成了粉紅色。
The future looks rosy for the young company.
這家年輕公司的前景看起來一片光明。
Things aren't as rosy as they seem.
事情並沒有看起來那麼美好。
The boat drifted downstream with the current.
小船順著水流往下游漂去。
We followed the river downstream for about an hour.
我們沿著河流往下游走了大約一小時。
Farms downstream were affected by the polluted water.
下游的農田受到汙水影響。
The downstream towns were warned about the flood.
下游的城鎮接獲了洪水警告。
The noise from the street roused me from sleep.
街上的噪音把我從睡夢中吵醒。
The speech roused the crowd to action.
這場演說激勵群眾採取行動。
We ordered clam soup at the seaside restaurant.
我們在海邊餐廳點了蛤蜊湯。
She dug for clams on the beach at low tide.
她在退潮時於海灘挖蛤蜊。
The horse began to gallop across the field.
馬開始在田野上飛奔。
The riders galloped along the beach at sunset.
騎士們在日落時沿著海灘策馬奔馳。
The horse broke into a gallop.
馬突然開始飛奔起來。
They crossed the valley at a gallop.
他們策馬飛奔穿越山谷。
The tiger was born in captivity and has never lived in the wild.
這隻老虎在圈養環境中出生，從未生活在野外。
He spent two years in captivity before being released.
他被囚禁了兩年才獲釋。
Manufactured goods are shipped to stores around the world.
製成品被運送到世界各地的商店。
The toy is a manufactured item, not a handmade one.
這個玩具是工廠製品，不是手工做的。
The factory uses a robotic arm to lift heavy boxes.
工廠用機械手臂搬運重箱子。
He spoke in a flat, robotic voice.
他用平板、像機器人一樣的聲音說話。

solomon.zh: 所羅門（聖經中以智慧著稱的以色列王）
ai: King Solomon is known in the Bible for his wisdom.
所羅門王在聖經中以智慧著稱。
People sometimes call a very wise judge a Solomon.
人們有時會把非常睿智的法官稱為所羅門。

cambridgeshire.zh: （地名）劍橋郡，英格蘭東部的郡
ai: Cambridgeshire is a county in the east of England.
劍橋郡是英格蘭東部的一個郡。
The city of Cambridge is located in Cambridgeshire.
劍橋市位於劍橋郡。

biker.zh: 騎機車的人、騎單車的人
ai: A group of bikers stopped at the cafe for lunch.
一群騎士停在咖啡館吃午餐。
The biker wore a helmet and gloves.
那位騎士戴著安全帽和手套。
The new law has serious ramifications for small businesses.
這項新法律對小型企業有嚴重的影響。
We must think about the ramifications before we decide.
我們在決定之前必須先想想可能的後果。
I feel sluggish after eating a big lunch.
吃完豐盛的午餐後，我覺得昏昏沉沉。
The old computer is sluggish when opening large files.
這台舊電腦開啟大檔案時很慢。
The sluggish economy made it hard to find a job.
經濟不景氣，找工作變得很困難。
Sales were sluggish during the summer months.
夏季幾個月的銷售很低迷。
I groped for the light switch in the dark.
我在黑暗中摸索電燈開關。
He groped around his bag for his keys.
他在包包裡摸來摸去找鑰匙。

venerable.zh: 德高望重的、年高受敬重的
ai: The venerable professor has taught at the school for fifty years.
這位德高望重的教授在這所學校任教五十年了。
They visited a venerable old temple in the mountains.
他們造訪了山中一座古老而受人敬重的寺廟。
Horse riding is a popular hobby in the countryside.
騎馬是鄉下很受歡迎的興趣。
She goes riding every Sunday morning.
她每個週日早上都會去騎馬。
Riding a bike to work saves me money.
騎腳踏車上班幫我省了錢。
A single drop of water can contain many microbes.
一滴水就可能含有許多微生物。
Washing your hands helps remove harmful microbes.
洗手有助於去除有害的微生物。
The lake looked serene in the early morning.
清晨的湖面看起來寧靜平和。
She gave a serene smile and closed her eyes.
她露出安詳的微笑，閉上了眼睛。
The company released a simplified version of the form.
公司發布了這份表格的簡化版。
This book uses simplified language for beginners.
這本書為初學者使用簡化的語言。
Good sanitation helps prevent the spread of disease.
良好的環境衛生有助於預防疾病傳播。
The village is building new sanitation facilities.
這個村莊正在興建新的衛生設施。

ruined.zh: 毀掉、搞砸（ruin 的過去式）
ai: The heavy rain ruined our picnic.
大雨毀了我們的野餐。
He ruined his shirt by washing it with a red sock.
他把襯衫和一隻紅襪子一起洗，結果毀了襯衫。
We explored a ruined castle on the hill.
我們探索了山丘上一座殘破的城堡。
The ruined walls were covered in green vines.
那些殘破的牆壁爬滿了綠色藤蔓。
A river runs through the deep gorge.
一條河流過深深的峽谷。
The hikers walked along the edge of the gorge.
登山客沿著峽谷邊緣行走。
The kids gorged themselves on cake at the party.
孩子們在派對上狼吞虎嚥地吃蛋糕。
After the long hike, we gorged on hot noodles.
長途健行後，我們大口吃著熱騰騰的麵。
A sudden gust of wind blew my hat off.
一陣突來的強風把我的帽子吹走了。
Gusts of wind rattled the windows all night.
整晚陣陣強風震得窗戶嘎嘎作響。
We brought a folding table to the picnic.
我們帶了一張摺疊桌去野餐。
A folding chair is easy to store in a small apartment.
摺疊椅很容易收納在小公寓裡。
The kitten has soft, fluffy fur.
這隻小貓有著柔軟蓬鬆的毛。
These pancakes are light and fluffy.
這些鬆餅又軟又蓬鬆。
She took over the chairmanship of the committee in January.
她在一月接任了委員會的主席職務。
The country will hold the chairmanship of the meeting next year.
該國明年將擔任這場會議的主席國。
A large tapestry hung on the castle wall.
城堡的牆上掛著一幅大型掛毯。
The tapestry shows a hunting scene in rich colors.
這幅掛毯以豐富的色彩描繪了一幕狩獵場景。
She studied pathology to become a doctor.
她研讀病理學，打算成為醫生。
The pathology report showed the cause of the illness.
病理報告顯示了這種疾病的成因。
She pushed the pram slowly through the park.
她推著嬰兒車慢慢地走過公園。
The baby fell asleep in the pram.
寶寶在嬰兒車裡睡著了。
I blurted out the secret before I could stop myself.
我還來不及阻止自己，就把祕密脫口而出。
He blurted that he had forgotten the tickets.
他脫口說他忘了帶票。

scandinavia.zh: （地名）斯堪地那維亞，北歐地區
ai: Norway and Sweden are part of Scandinavia.
挪威和瑞典屬於斯堪地那維亞地區。
Winters in Scandinavia are long and dark.
斯堪地那維亞的冬天漫長而昏暗。
Friends held a candlelight vigil outside the hospital.
朋友們在醫院外舉行了燭光守夜。
She kept a vigil by her sick mother's bed all night.
她整夜守在生病的母親床邊。
He sat uncomfortably on the small wooden chair.
他不舒服地坐在那張小木椅上。
The room was uncomfortably hot.
房間熱得讓人不舒服。
The young scientist challenged the old orthodoxy.
這位年輕的科學家挑戰了舊有的正統觀念。
Scientific orthodoxy can be slow to change.
科學上的正統看法有時很難改變。
They organized a nonviolent protest in the square.
他們在廣場上舉辦了一場非暴力抗議。
The group promised to use only nonviolent methods.
該團體承諾只使用非暴力的方式。

miami.zh: （地名）邁阿密，美國佛羅里達州城市
ai: Miami is a city in the state of Florida.
邁阿密是佛羅里達州的一座城市。
Many tourists visit Miami for its warm beaches.
許多遊客為了溫暖的海灘造訪邁阿密。

manhattan.zh: （地名）曼哈頓，紐約市的一個行政區
ai: Manhattan is one of the five boroughs of New York City.
曼哈頓是紐約市五個行政區之一。
The Empire State Building is located in Manhattan.
帝國大廈位於曼哈頓。
She made a compilation of her favorite songs.
她把自己最喜歡的歌曲做成了一張合輯。
The book is a compilation of short stories by different writers.
這本書是不同作家短篇故事的彙編。
I can't go out tonight because I'm broke.
我今晚不能出去，因為我沒錢了。
He went broke after his shop closed.
他的店關門後就破產了。

broke.zh: 打破、弄壞（break 的過去式）
ai: The glass fell and broke into pieces.
玻璃杯掉下去摔成了碎片。
She broke her arm while skiing.
她滑雪時摔斷了手臂。

philadelphia.zh: （地名）費城，美國賓夕法尼亞州城市
ai: Philadelphia is the largest city in Pennsylvania.
費城是賓夕法尼亞州最大的城市。
The Liberty Bell is displayed in Philadelphia.
自由鐘展示在費城。

minced.zh: 切碎、絞碎（mince 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: She minced the herbs and sprinkled them over the soup.
她把香草切碎，撒在湯上。
Add two cloves of minced garlic to the pan.
在鍋中加入兩瓣切碎的大蒜。
The recipe calls for minced beef and onions.
這份食譜需要牛絞肉和洋蔥。
Yorkshire is a large shire in northern England.
約克郡是英格蘭北部的一個大郡。
The old shire was divided into smaller districts.
這個古老的郡後來被分成幾個較小的行政區。
A narrow stairway leads to the attic.
一道狹窄的樓梯通往閣樓。
Please keep the stairway clear of boxes.
請不要在樓梯間堆放箱子。
We bought a small fir for the Christmas tree.
我們買了一棵小冷杉當聖誕樹。
Tall fir trees covered the mountain.
高大的冷杉樹覆蓋了整座山。
Workers will excavate the ground before building the tunnel.
工人在建造隧道之前會先挖開地面。
Archaeologists excavated an ancient village near the river.
考古學家在河邊挖掘出一座古老的村落。
The company is in the vanguard of green technology.
這家公司站在綠色科技的最前線。
The vanguard of the army reached the town first.
軍隊的先頭部隊最先抵達小鎮。
The coach spoke harshly to the team after the loss.
輸球後，教練對全隊說話很嚴厲。
The teacher was harshly criticized for the unfair test.
那位老師因為不公平的考試受到嚴厲批評。
The alarm rang harshly in the quiet hall.
警報聲在安靜的大廳裡刺耳地響起。
The sun shone harshly on the empty road.
烈日刺眼地照在空蕩蕩的路上。
The kids hollered from the yard when they saw the ice cream truck.
孩子們看到冰淇淋車，在院子裡大聲叫喊。
Don't holler at me, I can hear you.
別對我大吼，我聽得見。
We heard a holler from the other side of the field.
我們聽見田野另一頭傳來一聲叫喊。
Give me a holler if you need any help.
如果需要幫忙就喊我一聲。
We had a hearty breakfast before the long hike.
長途健行前，我們吃了一頓豐盛的早餐。
A bowl of hearty soup is perfect on a cold day.
天冷時來一碗料多實在的湯再好不過。
He gave us a hearty welcome at the door.
他在門口熱情地歡迎我們。
The team received hearty applause from the crowd.
球隊獲得了觀眾熱烈的掌聲。
The student faced expulsion for cheating on the exam.
那名學生因為考試作弊面臨被開除。
The expulsion of the diplomat caused a dispute between the two countries.
這名外交官被驅逐，引發了兩國之間的爭議。
The book is written in a friendly, conversational style.
這本書以親切、口語化的風格寫成。
She has basic conversational Spanish.
她具備基本的西班牙語會話能力。
The cornerback ran back to defend against the long pass.
角衛跑回去防守長傳。
A good cornerback must be fast and quick to react.
優秀的角衛必須速度快、反應敏捷。
Modernism changed the way artists thought about painting and writing.
現代主義改變了藝術家對繪畫與寫作的看法。
The building is a famous example of architectural modernism.
這棟建築是建築現代主義的知名範例。
Heavy traffic can adversely affect people's health.
嚴重的交通壅塞可能對人們的健康造成不良影響。
The long drought adversely affected the harvest.
長期乾旱對收成造成了不利影響。
The uniformity of the houses made the street look boring.
這些房子千篇一律，讓街道看起來很單調。
The teacher wanted more uniformity in how students formatted their essays.
老師希望學生的作文格式能更一致。

predominant.zh: 佔主導地位的、最主要的
ai: Rice is the predominant crop in this region.
稻米是這個地區最主要的作物。
Blue is the predominant color in her paintings.
藍色是她畫作中最主要的顏色。
I met a woman named Linda at the bus stop.
我在公車站遇到一位名叫琳達的女士。
They adopted a puppy named Biscuit.
他們領養了一隻名叫餅乾的小狗。

named.zh: 命名、提名（name 的過去式）
ai: They named their baby after her grandmother.
他們用她祖母的名字替寶寶取名。
The company named her the new manager last week.
公司上週任命她為新經理。
He gave up all his earthly possessions and became a monk.
他放棄了所有世俗財物，成為僧侶。
Some people believe earthly life is only temporary.
有些人相信人世間的生活只是暫時的。
There is no earthly reason to be so upset.
根本沒有理由這麼難過。
I have no earthly idea where he went.
我完全不知道他去哪了。
The government will subsidise the cost of electric buses.
政府將補助電動公車的成本。
Parents often subsidise their children's rent while they study.
孩子求學期間，父母常常會補貼他們的房租。
She was a finalist in the national speech contest.
她是全國演講比賽的決賽選手。
Four finalists will compete for the prize tomorrow.
四位入圍決賽的人明天將爭奪獎項。
The priest greeted each parishioner at the church door.
神父在教堂門口問候每一位教友。
Many parishioners volunteer to help at the local food bank.
許多教友自願到當地食物銀行幫忙。
The baby's bed has padded sides for safety.
嬰兒床的四周加了軟墊以策安全。
He wore a padded jacket in the cold wind.
寒風中他穿著一件鋪棉外套。
The elevator buttons have braille for blind users.
電梯按鈕上有點字，供視障者使用。
She learned to read braille at a special school.
她在一所特殊學校學會了讀點字。

houston.zh: （地名）休士頓，美國德州最大城市
ai: Houston is the largest city in Texas.
休士頓是德州最大的城市。
NASA's Johnson Space Center is located in Houston.
美國太空總署的詹森太空中心位於休士頓。
I couldn't decipher the doctor's handwriting.
我看不懂醫生的字跡。
Scientists worked for years to decipher the ancient writing.
科學家花了好幾年解讀這種古老的文字。
Osteoporosis makes bones weak and easy to break.
骨質疏鬆症會讓骨頭變脆弱、容易骨折。
Eating enough calcium can help prevent osteoporosis.
攝取足夠的鈣有助於預防骨質疏鬆症。
Overfishing can deplete the ocean's fish stocks.
過度捕撈可能耗盡海洋的魚類資源。
Running all day will deplete your energy quickly.
跑一整天會很快耗盡你的體力。
